description: N-15 SOTA Retrieval Quality Benchmark — graded relevance + gold facts for each fixture query. Relevance: 0=irrelevant, 1=tangential, 2=relevant, 3=essential. Gold facts derived from fixture source code, not invented.

queries.question: How does authentication work in this codebase?
gold_facts: authenticate_user validates credentials and issues access + refresh tokens
verify_session returns user id for a valid access token
logout revokes a refresh token by writing to the revocation list
SESSION_TTL is 1 hour and REFRESH_TTL is 30 days

queries.question: What are the main API endpoints?
gold_facts: POST /api/auth/login returns access + refresh tokens
POST /api/users creates a new user via sign-up flow
POST /api/billing/charge charges the authenticated user
POST /webhooks/stripe receives Stripe events

queries.question: Explain the billing flow from a user perspective.
gold_facts: charge_customer validates user, calls Stripe API, creates invoice and billing record
refund_charge issues a full refund and logs it in the refunds table
create_invoice writes an invoice row and returns it
list_user_invoices returns all invoices for a user newest first

queries.question: How are users stored in the database?
gold_facts: The users table has columns: id, email, password_hash, created_at, last_login, is_active
create_user inserts a new user and returns a User dataclass
deactivate_user performs a soft-delete by setting is_active to 0
get_connection returns a thread-local SQLite connection

queries.question: How does JWT signature verification work?
gold_facts: decode_token splits the token into 3 segments: header, payload, signature
signature verification uses hmac.compare_digest to prevent timing attacks
decode_token checks the exp claim against the current time
TokenExpiredError is raised when the token is expired

queries.question: What happens when a Stripe webhook fires?
gold_facts: verify_webhook validates the Stripe-Signature header with hmac.compare_digest
handle_webhook_event dispatches based on event type: charge.succeeded, charge.failed, charge.refunded
WEBHOOK_TOLERANCE_SEC is 300 seconds
WebhookVerificationError is raised on signature mismatch

queries.question: How do I create a new user?
gold_facts: create_user inserts into the users table with email, password_hash, created_at, is_active
create_user returns a User dataclass with the new id
the User dataclass has fields: id, email, password_hash, created_at, last_login, is_active
POST /api/users endpoint calls create_user

queries.question: Show me the refund logic.
gold_facts: refund_charge issues a full refund for a previous charge
refund_charge updates the charges status to 'refunded'
refund_charge inserts a row into the refunds table
BillingError is raised if the charge is already refunded

queries.question: What database does this project use?
gold_facts: The project uses SQLite as the database
The database file is stored at fixture.db
get_connection uses sqlite3.connect with check_same_thread=False
The schema is created lazily on first access via _ensure_schema

queries.question: How are invoices sent to users?
gold_facts: send_invoice_email renders an invoice and hands it to the email transport
send_invoice_email updates the invoices sent_at timestamp
list_user_invoices returns all invoices for a user ordered by created_at DESC
InvoiceNotFoundError is raised when referencing a missing invoice

queries.question: A user login is failing without any error message — which file contains credential validation?
gold_facts: authenticate_user calls verify_password with the plain password and stored hash
InvalidCredentialsError is raised when email or password does not match
verify_password uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison
authenticate_user calls get_user_by_email to look up the user

queries.question: Stripe webhooks are being rejected — where is the signature verified?
gold_facts: verify_webhook parses the Stripe-Signature header format 't=timestamp,v1=hex_signature'
signature verification uses hmac.new with sha256
the signed_payload is constructed as '{timestamp}.{payload}'
WebhookVerificationError is raised when the signature does not match

queries.question: Invoices are not appearing for a user — which files handle invoice retrieval?
gold_facts: list_user_invoices selects from the invoices table filtered by user_id
create_invoice inserts into the invoices table
send_invoice_email retrieves the invoice by id before sending
InvoiceNotFoundError is raised when the invoice id is not found

queries.question: Users are being logged out unexpectedly — where is token expiry enforced?
gold_facts: decode_token checks the exp claim against the current time
TokenExpiredError is raised when int(time.time()) exceeds int(exp)
verify_session calls decode_token to validate the access token
the exp claim in encode_token is converted from datetime to int timestamp

queries.question: I need to add an email_verified column to users — which files would change?
gold_facts: the users table schema is defined in db/connection.py _ensure_schema
the User dataclass in users/crud.py defines the canonical user record fields
create_user inserts email, password_hash, created_at, is_active into the users table
get_user_by_email returns a raw dict with id, email, password_hash, created_at, last_login, is_active

queries.question: I need to replace the database backend — which file owns the connection pool?
gold_facts: get_connection returns a thread-local sqlite3.Connection
_ensure_schema creates all fixture tables if they do not exist
the connection uses _DB_PATH which is fixture.db in the same directory as connection.py
close_all closes the thread-local connection if it exists

queries.question: I want to add multi-factor authentication to the login flow — which files would I modify?
gold_facts: authenticate_user is the login function that validates credentials and issues tokens
encode_token produces a signed JWT string from a claims dict
decode_token verifies signature + expiry and returns the claims dict
SESSION_TTL and REFRESH_TTL control token lifetimes in handlers.py

queries.question: I just changed how JWT tokens are signed — what other files should I review?
gold_facts: _sign uses hmac.new with JWT_SECRET and hashlib.sha256
decode_token calls _sign to compute the expected signature
verify_session calls decode_token to validate access tokens
encode_token sets the alg header to HS256

queries.question: I updated the charge_customer function — what else commonly changes with billing?
gold_facts: charge_customer validates the user, calls Stripe API, creates invoice and billing record
create_invoice is called inside charge_customer after a successful charge
charge_customer inserts into the charges table with user_id, stripe_id, amount_cents, status, created_at
BillingError is raised when the user is not chargeable
